text.p: Rhone Poulenc said on Monday its Rhone Merieux animal health unit planned to sell its diagnostics business to Synbiotics Corp. A spokeswoman said Rhone would not reveal price details.
"We are not communicating the price," said the spokeswoman.
Rhone said its 100-percent Merieux unit was the world's fourth largest animal health group and that the diagnostics business included laboratory reagents for detecting animal diseases.
It said Synbiotics would aquire the entire business including the research and development and marketing teams and the Rhone Merieux current revenues were about 60 million francs.
The department employing 30 people would remain in Lyon, it said. The statement said Rhone Merieux was concentrating on veterinary vaccines and medication.
